notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 (10.08.2019)
notes.notes:
Probably the most anticipated update for players.
A localization system was developed and implemented and the Russian language was immediately added. Many bugs were fixed and the moment with the collection of all cassettes was greatly simplified. Now the cassettes are in certain rooms in the same places all the time, and do not appear randomly depending on the position of the player. A critical bug has also been fixed, in which the monster could simply disappear to the very end and not appear even once in the whole game.
In fact, this update pays more attention to the planned work on the game, and especially work on the global update, which will significantly diversify and transform the gameplay.
One of these innovations is the addition of a new world and the continuation of history in it.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35465842/d72d4f014004322686b6a7d2530386048ea63da4.jpg
https://steamcdn-a.akamaimunity/ /images/clans/35465842/b7515acbdfc8e4e13180914dc7919f6022e9c8ec.jpg
The new world differs from the old one with an open and large forest with Russian nature, and the peculiarity of this world will be that it will have physical interactions with vegetation, such as trampling paths on the grass and the physical interaction of grass with solid objects.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35465842/00124a60de1161267c244e6aed2a110bd1e6ab17.jpg 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35465842/fa681427f76840018b8c906b986cb00d1cfada15.jpg 
It also has its own advanced wind system, which does not require directX 11 support.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35465842/5e0981052c77d996f33140283e6fa5368303340c.jpg [/ img]
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35465842/6137b64557c50290bb75dc5b86af440b22a9e995.jpg
With it, you can implement absolutely any and unique map of wind flows in the entire game world, which allows you to convey the whole atmosphere of the forest and open glades.
More information about this world can be found in the next updates.

What is planned in the near future?

 Add at least five new languages:

 Ukrainian
 Polish
 French
 Deutsch
 Belorussian

 Recycling all animations and bringing them to a different level
 Adding an introductory note that tells the beginning of a player’s story
 Adding three scenes: one for the ending, two others for the continuation of the game story, which will tell what happened and will happen next.
 Perhaps new characters will be added to the corridor, like the experimental of this doctor, with their small history and their mission in this reality, which greatly diversifies the horror part of the game in the corridor.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.03 (06.08.2019)
notes.notes:
This was one of the important updates, especially for the players.

 All prompts were moved to the main room
 The monster is now more predictable.
 Red flask for 1-2 minutes
 Using a blue bulb protects the player from the monster much better
 Added a button "Start again" after the death of a player.
 Added a localization system with the ability to support any language - 50%
 Added Russian language - 50%

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 (05.08.2019)
notes.notes:
In this update we did:

 5 leaflets were added with a hint on the passage of the game
 Added task menu
 Minor bugs have also been fixed

notes.title: UPDATE 1.01
notes.notes:
Due to the fact that the game began to play, many different flaws and errors began to appear. Some of them are critical, some are not very. Therefore, we will release interim updates in which we are fixing and finalizing something.

Some changes have been made to this update:

 A leaflet was added with brief instructions on how to complete the game
 Labels on unopened cabinets were disabled
 A critical error with mouse sensitivity relative to the aspect ratio of the screen has been fixed. Now the mouse moves vertically and horizontally at the same speed.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0
notes.notes:
After the appearance of the page on Steam, we are working on the first update of the game. The first version of the game will be released 03.08.2019

During the work on updating during the test more than twenty five bugs and defects were revealed.
It remains to correct and modify less than six points in the game and game will be completely ready to enter early access.

A couple of screenshots from the test. At the moment, finished work on the tapes and proceed to another.
